key_decisions.decision: Preserves status distinctions and both counts.
Retains named deities and evaluative language.
Keeps Molech rather than harmonizing Milcom; facing Jerusalem expresses the source relation without supplying a compass direction.
Keeps adversary as a human opponent raised by God.
Preserves the all-male slaughter and burial context.
Retains duration and repeated totalizing claim.
Keeps the child survivor and his companions.
Clarifies the slaughter’s referent while preserving the plural seizure of rule.
Makes the difficult added-harm clause readable without relocating rule to Edom.
Names the likely cloak wearer; ambiguity is noted.
Retains one despite twelve pieces and ten allotted.
Preserves the plural they and singular his father shift.
Preserves the lamp image and Name language.
Retains Jeroboam’s conditional house promise parallel to David’s.
Keeps the limit on affliction without specifying fulfillment.
